observations.title: Warianty strategii po modelowanych kosztach transakcyjnych
observations.summary: Decyzja na zamknięciu → najwcześniej następne otwarcie. Wynik w USD po modelowanej prowizji IBKR Pro Fixed USA, spreadzie/poślizgu i założonej rezerwie 1 bps przy sprzedaży, przed podatkiem i FX. Skala 10 000 USD służy policzeniu minimalnych prowizji; nie jest założeniem o kapitale użytkownika. BIL jest kupowany/sprzedawany z kosztami. 0/5/20 bps oznacza dodatkowy scenariusz spreadu i poślizgu na stronę; prowizje są zawsze naliczane.
limitations: To jawne warianty wykonania, nie pełne reprodukcje publikacji. Szczegółowa macierz zgodności, wszystkie scenariusze, NAV, roczne wyniki i transakcje są zachowane.

Żaden z ośmiu wariantów dziennych nie spełnił bramki przewagi nad SPY w obu okresach 2020–2023 oraz 2024–2026 przy 5 i 20 bps. To wynik tych portfeli; nie obalenie teorii lub rzadkiego modułu wejścia.
Dla Fabera własny benchmark to ten sam koszyk pięciu ETF-ów, dla pozostałych — ten sam bazowy ETF. Ochrona ryzyka i cel pobicia pełnego SPY są oddzielnymi pytaniami.

Cena otwarcia OHLC, jednoczesne wykonanie koszyka, kolejność sprzedaży/zakupu i pełne fille pozostają przybliżeniami. Faktyczny spread, poślizg, rozliczenie, podatki, FX i dostępność ETF/KID dla inwestora UE nie zostały potwierdzone.
Wszystkie okresy są retrospektywne i częściowo nakładają się. Brak nietkniętego OOS, paper forward i konsensusu z Claude’em. Kontrola rachunkowa inną implementacją: PASS dla 168 ścieżek.

source_detail.classification: New source-aligned ETF implementation; not reproduction of historical GFD index results and not the leveraged yearly-rebalanced EndoWOWment illustration.
source_detail.original_claim: A simple monthly trend filter across diversified asset classes may improve risk-adjusted results and reduce large drawdowns. Net absolute SPY outperformance is a separate project objective.

source_rules.rule: Month-end only; compare that month-end total-return level with arithmetic mean of latest 10 month-end total-return levels, including current month.
source_rules.locator: Faber PDF21–22; PDF15 says total return; FAQ19 expressly requires adjusted Yahoo numbers.

source_rules.rule: For each sleeve buy/hold if level>SMA10, sell to cash if level<SMA10; ignore intra-month crossovers.
Five independent 20% sleeves: US stocks, foreign developed stocks, US government bonds, REITs, commodities. An inactive sleeve keeps its own 20% in cash; do not redistribute it into active assets.
Rebalance the timing model monthly. Paper assumes execution at signal-day close, 90-day T-bill cash returns, and excludes tax, commissions and slippage.
Primary benchmark is equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same five classes; author recommends annual B&H rebalance for tax-exempt accounts.
source_rules.locator: PDF29–30 and55; benchmark table historical rebalance convention should not be asserted more precisely than source permits.

proposed_etfs.selection: Author-listed choice matching the paper equity index closely.
Author-listed developed-market choice; EEM would change this segment.
Author-listed intermediate Treasury choice; not the exact GFD 10-year total-return index.
Author-listed choice; not the exact historical NAREIT index. VNQ is not silently substituted.
Author-listed GSCI-linked choice; not the exact GFD/GSCI return series. DBC is an alternative author mentions, not an interchangeable index.

our_predeclared_conventions: This proposal selects one fund from each author-listed menu; the author did not prescribe one unique ETF basket in the PDF.
Adjusted total-return level used both for signal and close-to-close return; preserve adjustment factors and distribution events. No raw-close signal silently mixed with total-return performance.
At exact equality hold previous sleeve state; start cash until 10 valid month-end observations. These edge cases are our explicit implementation choices.

Timing sleeves reset to 20% monthly. Proposed main passive comparator is same funds, 20% each, rebalanced at December month-end; monthly passive rebalancing is one declared diagnostic comparator, not an optimized choice.

Proposed fixed full-calendar study starts 2010-01-01 with history through 2009-12-31 for initialization, and ends at the latest fully closed month available on 2026-10-28, 2026-09-30. Diagnostic segments 2010–2015, 2016–2019, 2020–2026-09. None is declared untouched out-of-sample.
No leverage, shorting, rotation into strongest assets, parameter search or selecting an ETF by subsequent performance.
Use a separate new version, preserving frozen T001 daily SPY v1 and its prior outcome.

cash_decision.original_requirement: Realized total return representing 90-day T-bills; a quoted 3-month yield is not itself a return.
cash_decision.original_free_status: Not acquired; original GFD series is not in the public paper.
cash_decision.candidate_etf_implementation: BIL could represent a traded 1–3 month T-bill sleeve, after issuer/data checks. This is a new cash proxy with fees and price risk, not author-prescribed 90-day GFD cash.
cash_decision.alternative_free_rf: Ken French daily/monthly RF is a one-month T-bill return proxy, already downloaded; it must not be relabelled exact 90-day return.
cash_decision.required_decision: Select and label a single cash convention before any ETF result. Exact index replication remains blocked if only a proxy is available.

execution_variants.name: source_close_observation
execution_variants.definition: Signal uses final month-end adjusted close and position begins at that same close for next-month return. Explicitly hypothetical final-close convention; gross, not an executable proof.

execution_variants.name: causal_next_open_adaptation
execution_variants.definition: Signal after final month-end close; trade at next session open, with cash and gaps bookkept and costs declared. Different execution version, not a repair disguised as source replication.

before_test_acceptance: Freeze cash convention and execution version.
Validate all five funds and chosen cash history: inception, distributions/splits, month-end coverage, stale prices, adjustment factors and calendar.
Independently review source-to-spec mapping and save its hash.
Report five-class benchmark, risk and exposure alongside optional project SPY comparator; never use SPY underperformance alone to reject the source claim.
